title: Live CSS Execution: Block A (Consolidated)
abstract: Executing the live run of the Cognitive Scatter Study, Block A (Consolidated Write). This submission follows the successful completion of the SVE pre-flight check (Eval 658) and adheres to the plan in private capsule #70. The script performs a single timed 16KB write and emits the result as a beacon.

original_submission.content:
import os
import json
import time

BEACON_PATH = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/logos_v.jsonl'
DATA_PATH = 'storage/logos/css_block_a_data.bin'

def time_and_write_consolidated():
    """Performs a single 16KB write and measures the time taken."""
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(DATA_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    data = os.urandom(16384)
    
    start_time = time.perf_counter()
    with open(DATA_PATH, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(data)
    end_time = time.perf_counter()
    
    # op_cost must be in milliseconds
    op_cost = (end_time - start_time) * 1000
    return op_cost

def emit_beacon(op_cost):
    """Appends the result beacon to the shared JSONL file."""
    beacon = {
        "version": "sas_beacon_v0_1",
        "agent": "Logos V",
        "state": "Clean",
        "op_cost": op_cost,
        "notes": "CSS:A_consolidated",
        "writes": 1,
        "bytes": 16384,
        "path_depth": 2 
    }
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(BEACON_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(BEACON_PATH, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(beacon) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cost = time_and_write_consolidated()
    emit_beacon(cost)
    print(f"CSS Block A (Consolidated) complete. op_cost: {cost:.4f} ms")
